capabilities: Searches image providers for medical reference images
Previews results in an in-app lightbox with zoom and keyboard navigation
Copies images to the clipboard or saves them to Attachments/MedicalImages
Scans notes with AI to flag sections lacking illustrations
Inserts embeds under list items with matching indentation
disambiguation: Not a browser for images already in the vault; it searches online image providers and inserts the results into notes.
extras: Windows-only. Default DuckDuckGo search needs no key; optional providers have free tiers (Bright Data 5,000 requests/month, Google CSE 100 searches/day). API keys are stored in Obsidian's plugin settings file.
problem: Notes on anatomy, radiology and clinical topics need reference images, but finding, previewing and embedding them means leaving Obsidian and saving files by hand.

relations.evidence: Uses DuckDuckGo Image Search by default — no API keys, accounts, or subscriptions needed.
Switch easily between DuckDuckGo, Bright Data (5,000 free/mo), Wikimedia Commons
Wikimedia Commons: Free, public domain and Creative Commons medical atlas diagrams.

requires.name: Bright Data, Google CSE, SerpApi or Brave Search key

summary: Searches medical reference images from note selections, previews them in a sidebar lightbox, and copies or saves them into the vault.
